criteria.description: Support contract: As an adopter, I can see supported platforms, Git configurations, interfaces, limits and qualification status.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP01 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Evolution rules: As an integrator, I know compatibility rules for facts, memory, policy, archives, journals and CLI JSON, including refusal/rollback limits.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP01/WP02/WP04 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Historical compatibility: As an existing user, I can read released-writer data and continue without rewriting it.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP02 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Incompatible-input refusal: As an operator, unsupported-format errors leave accepted history and private state unchanged.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP02/WP04 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Public recovery: As an operator, I can retain and restore code and collaboration/memory refs that ordinary clone omits.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP03 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Private recovery: As an operator, I have a tested private backup/restore procedure with freshness, fencing and exclusion rules.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP03/WP04 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Lost-device continuity: As an operator, I can use a distinct replacement actor without inferred roles and understand sole-authority loss.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP03 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Interrupted recovery: As an operator, I distinguish confirmed progress from uncertainty requiring reconciliation.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP04 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Provider qualification: As a migrator, I can inspect live-account observations by provider/profile/resource/direction and explicit loss.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP05 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass. Real provider/platform/adopter observations are required; absent access or a brief alone cannot count as passing proof.

criteria.description: Package qualification: As an installer, I can inspect exact package results by platform/variant and distribution limitations.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP06 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass. Real provider/platform/adopter observations are required; absent access or a brief alone cannot count as passing proof.

criteria.description: Practical limits: As an adopter, I have measured repository/history limits and recovery costs.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP07 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Boundary review: As an adopter, I can inspect credential, key, import, filesystem, authority and runner findings and disposition.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP08 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Adoption proof: As an adopter, I can inspect independent installation, collaboration, migration, upgrade and restore findings.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP09 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass. Real provider/platform/adopter observations are required; absent access or a brief alone cannot count as passing proof.

criteria.description: Truthful verdict: As an adopter, I can find current release docs and a beta verdict listing all unmet gates.
criteria.notes: Final integrated acceptance pending WP01/WP09 evidence and independent assessment; package approval alone is not a criterion pass.

criteria.description: Optional unified workflow: As an operator, I can explicitly enable one native contribution/moderation workflow without enabling it by default or coupling it to other opt-ins.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Open submission: As an unknown contributor, I can submit signed code or communications without upstream write access, a provider account or prior project role.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Bounded intake: As a maintainer, I can inspect pending submissions through isolated validation with finite per-request and aggregate resource limits before shared visibility.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Operation authority: As a project, I apply common admission machinery with distinct permissions for creation, replies, edits, moderation, proposal admission and existing merge/execution.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Native moderation: As a moderator, I can record authorized scoped admit/reject, hide/restore and author block/unblock decisions with exact targets and visible conflicts.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Portable contribution lifecycle: As an observer, I can reconstruct pending/admitted state and moderation from immutable signed Git-backed records, preserving deduplication and interrupted recovery.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Public-contribution proof: As an adopter, I can reproduce a provider-free stranger-to-project journey and hostile-input refusals in standard/native-only builds.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.
